definition.volumePOC: price bin with max volume in the 60m rolling window
definition.timePOC: price bin with max seconds stayed in the 60m rolling window
definition.valueArea: price bins covering 70% of rolling volume
definition.outside_revert: above value area => DOWN, below value area => UP
definition.outside_continue: above value area => UP, below value area => DOWN
definition.reenter: signal when price comes back into value area
